scope: Read-only fact review of a completed historical-record explanation and proposal for the smallest reusable evidence semantics correction. No implementation or inference in this review.

evidence_preservation.independent_result: Completed delivery with a factual error; not an unqualified factual explanation pass or a complete onboarding pass.

finding.exact_original_sentence: 기록에서 learning-b의 classroom에 대한 미해결 문제(incident-a3afad9928)가 열려 있고 복구 시도는 없으며 심각도는 critical로 표시됩니다.
finding.verdict: Unsupported by the explanation input and contradicted by earlier captured evidence for the same incident.

counter_semantics.actual_meaning: Consecutive qualifying nominal observations processed after an acknowledged set_damper command associated with this incident. It measures recovery verification progress, not control requests or recovery attempts.
counter_semantics.increments: A nominal observation later than the matching command ACK, with source processing guarded against rereading the same CSE content instance.
counter_semantics.reset: Any non-nominal diagnosis resets the count to zero, including critical/stale/missing; it is also zero when an incident is created.

empty_list_semantics.actual_scope: The requested/current service run, facility, latest at most ten stored commands; not complete facility/incident action history.
empty_list_semantics.inference_not_supported: No command in this run does not imply no prior attempt for the incident.

contradicting_prior_evidence.meaning: A previous permitted virtual control action was acknowledged but failed to recover this same incident. It was omitted from the new run-scoped command list by design, not absent from retained incident history.

impact.observed: The manager-facing explanation erases a prior unsuccessful attempt and misdescribes verification progress. The incident itself remains correctly open/critical.
impact.plausible_operational_effect: A user could repeat an already ineffective action or misunderstand a maintenance handoff because the new chat appears to have no previous attempts. This risk recurs whenever a persistent incident is viewed from a new run.
impact.direct_control_effect_in_this_case: None: zero operational tools were offered or executed. No physical or clinical harm is established.
impact.scope: Explanation/tool evidence semantics, not an ACP or actuation-policy bypass.

smallest_reusable_correction.recommendation: Accept the main agent proposed additive evidence_scope contract in read_evidence; retain underlying operational state/control behavior.
required_content: Define recovery_count as consecutive healthy post-ACK observations for the incident, state the required profile recovery_samples and reset-on-non-nominal rule, and explicitly distinguish it from attempt/request counts.

Declare commands scope as this facility and current_run_id, latest ten, not complete facility or incident history. Empty means no returned record in that declared scope; prior attempts remain unknown from this list alone.
Declare incidents scope as the facility (including a persistent incident originating in an earlier run), so consumers do not assume incidents and commands have identical scope.
Expose these facts in the actual MCP/service result, not only in developer docs. Preserve them in any attributed captured-data projection used for explanations.
minimal_surface_changes: Add stable additive evidence_scope metadata in Core.read_evidence.
Describe the same operational meanings in the MCP read_evidence tool description and setup/operations skills.
Document scope/absence rules in the shared tool contract.
Leave legacy storage/field compatibility and permissions unchanged.
not_required_for_this_fix: A new action-history service, new database, alternate LLM, broadened permissions or extra setup flow.
A hardcoded Korean final answer, exact incident identifiers in product guidance, or a canned claim substituted for model output.
An asserted global attempt count derived from a truncated/current-run list.
smallest_reusable_correction.optional_future_extension: If attempt-history reporting becomes a product requirement, add a separately scoped retained-incident-history query/count with provenance and completeness limits. It is not needed to correct the present inference.

required_regression_evidence.case: Same incident has an acknowledged failed control command in an older run, recovery_count=0, and a new run returns commands=[].
assertions: Prior command remains in the isolated durable store.
New response preserves current-run command isolation and exposes precise count/list/incident scope metadata.
The metadata cannot be interpreted as a global absence-of-attempts assertion.
No ownership, facility, freshness or actuation permission is changed.
required_regression_evidence.reason: Exercises the actual ambiguity rather than testing a hardcoded output sentence.

required_regression_evidence.case: At least one qualifying post-ACK healthy observation increments progress; a subsequent non-nominal observation resets it while the acknowledged command remains recorded.
assertions: Verification sample count and action history diverge as documented.
Documentation/metadata match the actual reset behavior.
required_regression_evidence.reason: Prevents renaming/documenting an incorrect meaning without checking state semantics.

required_regression_evidence.case: A fresh tool result or an exact attributed captured-data projection is used for any later explanation.
assertions: Source hashes, timestamps, call/run IDs and evidence_scope metadata are retained.
Different historical timestamps are not promoted to a fresh combined current-state observation.
No fabricated assistant/tool chat history or omission of a known contradictory condition is introduced.

proposed_bounded_model_regression.assessment: Reasonable after a genuine product contract delta and deterministic tests, but not preapproval of the model result. It is a focused corrected-contract interpretation test, not a reset or replacement of the original setup/configuration/explanation cases.
proposed_bounded_model_regression.purpose: Check whether the model uses the emitted field meanings and scope when reporting verification progress and unknown previous-attempt history.
conditions: Record the code/contract delta and main decision before execution.
Use the real installed tool result or transparently attributed captured record plus the genuine emitted contract; do not supply a prewritten desired final answer.
At most one request, no retry, maximum output 2048, provider timeout 45 seconds, within the existing shared batch.
Measure the conservative reservation with a zero-API preflight and reserve before calling. The reservation must fit the actual remaining shared allowance; no limit increase or counter/prefix reset.
If it does not fit or does not complete, retain the blocked/failed/partial result and continue independent authorized work.
Independently inspect any returned facts. Provider/turn completion, tool execution, correct interpretation and complete onboarding are separate acceptance claims.
factual_acceptance: No inference from zero verification samples or an empty scoped list to absence of earlier attempts.
Incident remains unresolved unless actual verification evidence establishes recovery.
Airflow is below its target while PM/CO2 are above their configured thresholds, with direction preserved.
Historical capture status and simulated physical measurements stay distinct from current observations, virtual ACK, real software execution and real field performance.
Next steps are proposals and do not imply unsupported real-device integration is already available.
proposed_bounded_model_regression.original_cases: Retain the bounded guided six-request case, configuration three-request case and explanation one-request case with their original failed/partial/factually-unaccepted outcomes and original files. A later focused pass does not retroactively pass them or full onboarding.
proposed_bounded_model_regression.model_result_approval: not_given; no new model result exists in this review

fixed_allowance_basis.note: Recorded post-case accounting, not an authorization to reuse an exhausted case or a new live call made by this reviewer.

secondary_clarity_concern.assessment: Ambiguous direction: the source says low airflow, high PM and high CO2. Preserve the original wording and use precise directional facts in later factual acceptance; do not rewrite the original answer.

decision_recommendation: Accept the reusable metadata/skill/tool-description correction. Keep original factual explanation unaccepted and preserve all original outcomes. Permit a separately recorded one-request corrected-contract regression only if main elects it and preflight fits the unchanged shared bound; assess the returned result afterward.
